title: [Activity] Running User and Item-Based KNN on MovieLens

cues.en: Okay, so let's head back to Spyder and this time have a look at the KNNBakeOff file inside our CollaborativeFiltering folder.
cues.zh: 好，回到 Spyder，這次看看 CollaborativeFiltering 資料夾中的 KNNBakeOff 檔案。

cues.en: As I said, SupriseLib will do most of the work for us here, we just have to tell it what we want it to do.
cues.zh: 如前所述，SurpriseLib 會替我們處理大部分工作，只要告訴它想做什麼。

cues.en: We're importing the KNNBasic package, because that's what implements both user-based and item-based KNN recommendations as we've described them.
cues.zh: 匯入 KNNBasic 套件，因為它實作了剛才描述的使用者式與項目式 KNN 推薦。

cues.en: All we do is create one instance with the user-based set to true and another to false, and pit them against each other, and also the random recommender as a baseline.
cues.zh: 只要建立兩個實例，一個把 user_based 設為 True，另一個設為 False，讓兩者比較，也用隨機推薦作為基準。

cues.en: We'll print out accuracy metrics, but in the interest of time, we'll just sample the top-N recommender results.
cues.zh: 我們會印出準確程度指標，但為了節省時間，只抽看 Top-N 推薦結果。

cues.en: You can certainly pass true to the Evaluate function if you want to get hit rate metrics as well, but it will take a lot longer to run.
cues.zh: 如果也想取得命中率指標，當然可以向 Evaluate 函數傳入 True，但執行時間會長很多。

cues.en: Let's kick it off and we'll come back in a few minutes when it's done.
cues.zh: 開始執行，幾分鐘後完成再回來。

cues.en: So, let's take a look at the accuracy results.
cues.zh: 看看準確程度結果。

cues.en: This is interesting, both user-based and item-based had about the same accuracy score here.
cues.zh: 有趣，使用者式與項目式的準確程度分數，幾乎相同。

cues.en: User-based came out slightly better, but it's so slight, I don't think we can really read anything into that.
cues.zh: 使用者式略好，但差異太小，我認為無法據此得出什麼結論。

cues.en: Both outperformed random recommendations substantially, so that's a good thing.
cues.zh: 兩者都明顯勝過隨機推薦，是好事。

cues.en: It's doing something useful for sure.
cues.zh: 它確實做了有用的事。

cues.en: So just based on those accuracy scores, we might conclude that KNN recommendations are a pretty good idea, certainly one worth trying out in production.
cues.zh: 只看這些準確程度分數，可能會認為 KNN 推薦很不錯，至少值得在正式環境嘗試。

cues.en: But let's take a look at the actual recommendations we got back for our test user, our friend user number 85.
cues.zh: 但看看測試使用者，我們的朋友使用者 85，實際得到的推薦。

cues.en: I don't know about you, but I haven't heard of a single one of these movies in the user-based results.
cues.zh: 不知道你如何，但使用者式結果中的電影，我一部也沒聽過。

cues.en: It's hard to believe these movies are such great recommendations that they warrant a five-star prediction from someone with similar interests to myself when I've never even heard of any of them.
cues.zh: 對與我興趣相似的人而言，很難相信這些電影是好到值得預測五顆星的推薦，因為我一部都沒聽過。

cues.en: Maybe they're great and I would love them if I watched them, but it seems suspect.
cues.zh: 也許它們很棒，我看了就會喜歡，但似乎有點可疑。

cues.en: The item-based results aren't any better, in terms of recognizability.
cues.zh: 就辨識度而言，項目式結果也沒有比較好。

cues.en: I've never heard of any of these, either.
cues.zh: 這些我也一部都沒聽過。

cues.en: Even if these are great recommendations, it's not really generating any user trust in the recommender system if all you recommend are obscure items.
cues.zh: 即使是好推薦，如果全是冷門項目，也無法真正建立使用者對推薦系統的信任。

cues.en: The random recommendations actually look a lot better from a subjective standpoint, when we look at the top-N results.
cues.zh: 從主觀角度看 Top-N 結果，隨機推薦反而好得多。

cues.en: So, on the surface, it looks like we may have made a system that's pretty good at predicting ratings of movies people have already seen, but might not be very good at producing top-N recommendations.
cues.zh: 因此，表面上，我們可能做出一個很會預測已看過電影評分，卻不太會產生 Top-N 推薦的系統。

cues.en: This is yet another example of how focusing on offline accuracy metrics can lead you to the wrong conclusions.
cues.zh: 這又是一個例子，說明專注於離線準確程度指標，可能導致錯誤結論。
